acceptance_cases: Reject generic BOE times oil price as revenue
Require heat content before Mcf/MMBtu conversion
Preserve gross versus net volume and prevent duplicate royalty subtraction
Keep daily and full-period sensitivities distinct
Retain EOG positive volume and negative price contributions separately
Do not relabel raw CFO minus selected capex as issuer FCF
Include SLB APS and capitalized data in its stated FCF reconciliation
Keep EQT consolidated and attributable cash measures distinct
Apply NCI consistently to cash, capital and debt claims
Do not equate a distribution waterfall share with legal equity ownership
Preserve option holder on every index election
Do not recognize 2027 contract economics as current deliveries
Keep announced contract capacity separate from selected/delivered volume
Do not treat a general SPA description as universal contract terms
Keep unavoidable fee separate from marginal cargo lifting cost
Preserve NPNS scope denominator and designation date
Do not call NPNS balance reclassification cash generation
Retain residual derivatives and deferred-basis amortization
Separate FID, first output, substantial completion and contract start
Value contributed assets and foregone earnings in project counterfactual
Do not turn revenue mix into EBITDA/cash exposure weights
Flag Valero West Coast changed asset perimeter
Keep issuer published ratio when rounded inputs cannot reproduce it exactly
Exclude temporary LIFO benefit from a recurring-margin claim
Keep acquired-current, organic and pro forma growth definitions separate
Do not force segment acquisition contributions to sum before elimination reconciliation
Do not assign SaaS economics to an entire Digital or AI-associated business
Do not transform turnkey well awards into profit without cost terms
Preserve source rig-activity definitions and regional coverage
Product supplied remains a demand proxy, not direct final consumption
Retain original and corrected storage vintages with knowledge times
Reject employee-plan 11-K as corporate 10-K despite matching issuer/name
No numeric theme weight from undisclosed exposure
No cheap/expensive or surprise label without matched valuation/expectations data
No interest double count across unlevered/levered valuation methods
Research associations never change basket, rank, entry, sizing or trading authority
